test_title: PYST 58: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Match the sports in List I with the sportsperson in List II who were in the news for their sports achievement in 2022:

 
 

 LIST I - Sportsman
 LIST II - Sports
 
 
 
 

 A. Lakshya Sen
 i. Boxing
 
 

 B. Rameshbabu Pragnanandhaa
 ii. Badminton
 
 

 C. Nikhat Zareen
 iii. Shooting
 
 

 D. Rudrankksh Patil
 iv. Chess
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Lakshya Sen** is a prominent Indian badminton player who gained significant attention in 2022 for his performances in international badminton tournaments.
 
• **Rameshbabu Pragnanandhaa** is a young Indian chess prodigy who made headlines in 2022 by defeating world champion Magnus Carlsen in an online chess tournament.
 
• **Nikhat Zareen** is an Indian boxer who achieved a major milestone in 2022 by winning a gold medal at the Women's World Boxing Championships.
 
• **Rudrankksh Patil** is an Indian shooter who gained recognition in 2022 for his achievements in shooting sports, particularly in events like the ISSF Junior World Cup.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Badminton**

 
 
• Badminton is a racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net.
 
• It may be played with larger teams, the most common forms of the game are "singles" (with one player per side) and "doubles" (with two players per side).
 
• Since 1992, it has been a Summer Olympic sport with five events: men's singles, women's singles, men's doubles, women's doubles, and mixed doubles.
 
 
 
• **Chess**
 
 
• Chess is a two-player strategy board game played on a chessboard, a checkered gameboard with 64 squares arranged in an 8×8 grid.
 
• Chess is believed to have originated in India and spread to Persia and then to the Islamic world, Europe, and the rest of the world.
 
• Chess is one of the world's most popular games, played by millions of people worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Boxing**
 
 
• Boxing is a combat sport in which two people, usually wearing protective gloves, throw punches at each other for a predetermined amount of time in a boxing ring.
 
• Amateur boxing is both an Olympic and Commonwealth Games sport and is a common fixture in most international games.
 
• Boxing is overseen by a referee over a series of one- to three-minute intervals called rounds.
 
 
 
• **Shooting**
 
 
• Shooting is the act or process of discharging firearms or other projectile weapons such as bows or crossbows.
 
• It is a competitive sport involving tests of accuracy and speed using various types of guns such as firearms and airguns.
 
• The shooting sports are categorized by the type of firearm, targets, and distances at which the targets are shot.
